expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "this is over-split for what it is. I'd collapse it... that cost is higher, not lower, when AI assistants are doing most of the editing."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "Collapse to one file... UserBadge.tsx # types + logic (hook) + styles + JSX, in that reading order."

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
expectations.evidence: Notes a 'view that's just JSX can't be understood... without the logic and types open beside it' and that an agent 'adds a prop in view but forgets types,' but attributes it to context-load/sync cost, not the agent's unwillingness to fetch the sibling shaping the view's props.

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
expectations.evidence: "Styles earn their own file when there's a lot of them, or your styling lib mandates it (e.g. CSS/SCSS modules — which... you'd want as UserBadge.module.scss)." Defends a separate stylesheet as a real exception rather than blanket-merging.
